scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts AvyoIntro out/avyo-intro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:webm: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts AvyoIntro out/avyo-intro.webm --codec vp9 --crf 32
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts AvyoIntro out/avyo-intro-poster.jpg --frame 480 --image-format jpeg --jpeg-quality 85
